cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your school meeting went fine, love. The headteacher and I discussed your suspension. Have some tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. A little while. I'll be home with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will I miss the school play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart. Come sit beside me. You don't have to face this alone.

mechanism: A corrects a child's attempts to establish the suspension timetable while substituting increasingly information-free care.
confusable: Simple secretiveness is not D141; warmth must stay present while answers disclose progressively less.
comparison: Family reassurance differs from a customer-service worker restricting collection options.
seedUse: Keep suspension and school-play questions, using S03 to police the child's interpretation of each answer.
